body.title: Add the degraded state marker + assembleDiffGrounding dep seam
body.summary: Add optional groundingMode?: 'degraded' to CodeReviewStepStatePayload (src/mcp/code-review-step/types.ts) so the judgements turn knows to drive runCodeReview with the degraded+cap options, and add assembleDiffGrounding: typeof assembleDiffCodeReviewGrounding to CodeReviewStepDeps (src/mcp/code-review-step/handler.ts) with a real default wired into DEFAULT_DEPS. Both additive; the existing subject + optional grounding fields + s9 seams unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: CodeReviewStepDeps carries assembleDiffGrounding wired to the real assembleDiffCodeReviewGrounding in DEFAULT_DEPS

tests.name: state/deps: a saved CodeReviewStepStatePayload with groundingMode:'degraded' round-trips through saveState/loadState, and DEFAULT_DEPS.assembleDiffGrounding is the real assembler
